title: Workflow events
subtitle: Relay of rag events to ag.flow workflow.
intro: Gate A: each event is emitted to workflow inside an HMAC-signed envelope, through a robust outbox (retries, deduplication). The rag.workspace.created.v1 event is emitted when a workspace is created.

fields.enabled_help: Enables event emission to workflow. With no whitelisted event, nothing is relayed even when enabled.
fields.source_id_help: GUID assigned by workflow to this rag source.

events.title: Events whitelist
events.help: Whitelist: empty = no event relayed even when the relay is enabled.
events.empty: No emittable event declared by rag.

test.not_configured: Configure the URL, source and secret first.
